description: Numeric cache of y_λ(q_0) at 50 dps for n ∈ {2, ..., 12}, evaluated from y-lambda-wenzl-bridge-symbolic-witness.json in parallel via multiprocessing.Pool. Pre-computes the expensive symbolic-to-numeric step so downstream consumers (delta_lambda_empirical_tabulation.py and other ρ_K Wedderburn-weighted formulas) can load instantly. Output strings trimmed to exactly 50 dps via mp.nstr.
